meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via the selected gateway. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给智能体换上能自主规划、调度工具并续接会话的新推理后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给 Agent 换一个推理后端,同时保留会话历史与工具能力。
copy.tagline_en: Swap your agent onto a backend that plans, calls tools, and resumes sessions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to run on a different provider while keeping history and tools.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个 Codex 后端:某个群组的干活大脑可以从 Claude 换成 OpenAI 的 Codex,由它规划、调用 MCP 工具、在服务端保存对话历史并续接会话。凭证只存进 OneCLI vault,容器内读不到真实密钥。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个群组（或新建群组）的 provider 换成 codex 并重启,或执行本技能的安装、vault 认证步骤时接管。

say.text: 把 Codex 装成 provider,并带我做认证
把群组 <group-id> 的 provider 换成 codex 并重启
say.note: 执行按群组的配置更新与重启命令

say.text: 让新建的群组默认用 codex
say.note: 装完会先问你,同意后才改默认值并重启主机

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as an agent provider so a group's backend can run Codex instead of Claude: planning, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume. Credentials stay in the OneCLI vault.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you switch a group's provider to codex and restart it, or run the skill's install and vault auth steps.

say_en.text: Install Codex as a provider and walk me through auth
say_en.note: Copies files, adds the CLI manifest, rebuilds, then vault auth.

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to codex and restart it
say_en.note: Runs the per-group provider update and restart commands.
Asks first, then sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER and restarts the host.
